Family review describes Hesperiidae superposition optics and variable duplicated opsins. The 2022 study reports in-vitro LW maxima for Achalarus lyciades and Epargyreus clarus, not Pholisora; these differing pigments and widespread lepidopteran spectral variation do not establish a genus value or a spectral-range bound.
